GMCB staff have posted individual hospital budget materials as they have been submitted and the Board is accepting public comment on the FY2027 Hospital Budget Review now through Friday, September 11, 2026. Hearings are scheduled to begin Monday, August 3, 2026. 

GMCB accepted public comment on the AHS 2026 Health Care Workforce Development Strategic Plan as was presented to the Board on Wednesday, July 8, 2026.  Comments were accepted through Monday, July 13, 2026. 

AHS has updated the 2026 Health Care Workforce Development Strategic Plan and the Board is expected to vote on the updated version on Wednesday, October 7th.  Public comments will be accepted until Monday, October 5, 2026.

GMCB is accepting public comments on the proposed 2027 health insurance rate filings through July 27, 2026. Additionally, a virtual Public Comment Forum will be held on Thursday, July 23rd at 4:00 p.m. to provide Vermonters with an opportunity to share their perspectives directly with GMCB.

2026

July

GMCB accepted public comments on the proposed 2027 health insurance rate filings through July 27, 2026. Additionally, a virtual Public Comment Forum was held on Thursday, July 23rd at 4:00pm.

GMCB accepted public comment on the AHS 2026 Health Care Workforce Development Strategic Plan as was presented to the Board on Wednesday, July 8, 2026.  Comments were accepted through Monday, July 13, 2026. 

June

GMCB accepted public comment on the Data Governance Council's Submitter's Communication Standard Operating Procedure (SOP) as presented on Wednesday, May 27, 2026.  Public comments were accepted through Tuesday, June 30, 2026.

No comments were received.

May

The Board accepted public comment on the Data Governance Council's (DGC) revised Reporting Manual through Thursday, May 7, 2026.

The Board accepted public comment on the draft FY2027 Accountable Care Organization (ACO) Certification Guidance through May 4, 2026. This guidance outlines the requirements and expectations for ACO certification for organizations seeking to operate in Vermont under applicable Vermont law and GMCB Rule 5.000.

No comments were received.

March

The Board accepted public comment on the Department of Vermont Health Access's (DVHA) proposed benefit design for the plan year 2027 Qualified Health Plans as presented to the Board on March 11, 2026.  Public comments were accepted through March 17, 2026. No comments were received.

The Board accepted public comment on the draft FY27 Hospital Budget Guidance. The Guidance outlines the framework and expectations that will guide Vermont hospitals as they develop their FY27 budgets and support the Board’s work to improve affordability, access, and quality of care for Vermonters. The special public comment period is open through March 27, 2026, although the GMCB accepts public comments at any time.  Additional FY2027 hospital budget guidance materials, supporting documents, and related resources are available to help inform public review and comment.

January

The Board accepted public comment on the new draft Hospital Budget Review Rule (Rule 3.000) January 01, 2026, through February 25, 2026. The proposed rule updates and clarifies the standards and processes for hospital budget submissions, reviews, and corrective actions. The Board voted unanimously to accept the draft on Wednesday, November 19, 2025. The draft was then submitted to the Interagency Committee on Administrative Rules (ICAR) in November 2025.

After acceptance by ICAR, the Board submitted the Proposed Rule to the Secretary of State's office in December 2025. The Board heard updates to the Proposed Rule at a hearing on February 18, 2026. The Board may submit a Final Proposed Rule to the Legislative Committee on Administrative Rules (LCAR) and the Secretary of State's office after the public comment period closes.

Public Comments received

  • Julie Wasserman
  • Vermont Association of Hospitals and Health Systems (VAHHS)
  • BlueCross BlueShield of Vermont (BCBS-VT)

The Board accepted public comment on the new draft ACO Oversight Rule, prior to filing the rule with Interagency Committee on Administrative Rules (ICAR) and Legislative Committee on Administrative Rules (LCAR), through January 23, 2026. 

The Board accepted public comment on the draft revised Certificate of Need (CON) monetary jurisdictional thresholds bulletin through January 30, 2026. No public comments were received.
